summary: Fixed statsmodels/formula (all 19 tests in test_formula.py now pass: added tools.testing.assert_equal, pandas-aware predict with formula NA handling, RegressionResults.get_prediction), and worked through genmod GLM (pinv_wexog/normalized cov via pinv of the weighted design, GLM summary/summary2, concentrated Gaussian llf, binomial proportion variance with n_trials as weights, Gamma loglike, IRLS history/convergence, null model, perfect-separation warning, weight defaults, prediction-result aliases, qif summary); test_glm.py plus genmod/families tests went from 127 failing to about 86 failing, while the other share files (gee, gam, penalized, constrained, bayes_mixed_glm, glm_weights, smooth_basis) were only partially examined and remain largely failing. No full-suite run was done, so the last full-suite result is not recorded.
